recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If the HSPC registry entry needs to be restored or adjusted later, handle that in the IG registry or HSPC publication source rather than the current FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-10545 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core profiles reporting that the IG Registry linked to the broken HSPC URL http://www.fhir.org/guides/hspc/history.html, while http://fhir.org/guides/hspc was valid.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-10545 source commit was found. Historical source shows the HSPC IG entry was commented out in source/igs.xml before the issue was filed, source/fhir.ini now only has a commented HSPC dictionary entry, and no HSPC guide files are currently tracked in core source.
additional_context: Current FHIR core source links readers to the external IG Registry but does not maintain an active HSPC registry entry. The live registry page returned 200 and contained no HSPC links; the obsolete /guides/hspc/history.html URL still returned 404 while the HSPC guide root returned 200. Community searches found no directly relevant discussion or minutes that would change the source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source changes because the current core build source does not emit the broken HSPC history URL and the current registry output no longer links to it.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive technical correction reporting that the IG Registry linked to the broken HSPC history.html URL while the HSPC guide root worked.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the approved request and the specific broken URL under review.

evidence_items.summary: The HSPC IG entry in igs.xml and the HSPC dictionary entry in fhir.ini are both commented out.
evidence_items.learned: HSPC is not active current core build content, so changing that inactive entry would not fix the current spec.

evidence_items.summary: The current home page links to the external IG Registry but not directly to HSPC or the broken HSPC history URL.
evidence_items.learned: The inspected current core source does not emit the obsolete broken target.

evidence_items.summary: The July 2016 commit 'remove Implementation guides, and work on foundation module' commented out the HSPC IG entry in source/igs.xml.
evidence_items.learned: HSPC had already been removed from active core IG source before FHIR-10545 was filed.

evidence_items.locator: Negative community search for FHIR-10545 and HSPC
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-10545" OR HSPC' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search fts '"FHIR-10545" OR HSPC' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-10545
evidence_items.summary: No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence hits for the Jira decision were found; HSPC hits were unrelated background references.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community record changes the Jira/source conclusion.

evidence_items.locator: Live registry and HSPC URL checks
evidence_items.command: curl -L -I https://www.fhir.org/guides/registry/; curl -L -I http://www.fhir.org/guides/hspc/history.html; curl -L -I https://fhir.org/guides/hspc/; curl -fsSL https://www.fhir.org/guides/registry/ | rg -i 'hspc|healthcare services platform|guides/hspc'
evidence_items.summary: The registry page returned 200 and contained no HSPC links; the old HSPC history.html URL returned 404 and the HSPC guide root returned 200.
evidence_items.learned: The obsolete target remains invalid, but the current registry output no longer links to it.
